description: Time-series forecasting: forecast any BigQuery table with Google's pretrained TimesFM model (AI.FORECAST), nothing to train. Point it at the table, timestamp column and value column and get forecast rows with bounds for the horizon you set, per series with id_cols. Use it for sales, traffic, demand or metric forecasts. Input: table, timestamp_col, data_col; optional horizon, id_cols. $10.00 per call. Returns: table, timestamp_col, data_col, horizon, columns[], rows[], row_count, gib_processed.

id_cols.description: Optional: forecast multiple series at once.

language.description: Optional BCP-47 language tag (en, ja, ko, pt-BR): the human-readable strings of the result (notes, details, reasons) are translated into this language; data, codes, numbers and URLs are untouched. Default: as produced.

name: hubvibe_data_forecast
title: Forecast a time series
